# MME Medical

> MME Medical is a comprehensive medical equipment supplier offering new, recertified, and used devices from leading manufacturers for emergency response and healthcare facilities.

MME Medical specializes in sourcing and distributing medical equipment across multiple categories including defibrillators, monitors, ventilators, and training accessories. The company partners with industry-leading brands such as Zoll, Philips, Medtronic, and Laerdal to provide healthcare providers with quality equipment options at various price points.

- Medical Equipment Catalog

- Automated External Defibrillators (AEDs)
